_comment: 말씀 카드 그림의 인물 기준(얼굴·옷이 장마다 변하지 않게 — 사용자 2026-11). 장면 글에 이름(names)이 나오면 그 인물의 기준 그림(<key>.png, cards.mjs refs로 만든다)을 함께 넣는다. 옷 색은 3D 무대 피규어(stage/people.js)와 맞춤. not: 이 말이 함께 나오면 다른 사람(동명이인)

mary.desc: Mary of Nazareth, the mother of Jesus: young Galilean Jewish woman with a gentle oval face, dark brown hair under a deep blue mantle worn as a veil over a warm red-brown dress. In later scenes (when Jesus is grown) she is about forty-five with the same face, slightly older.

peter.desc: Simon Peter: broad-shouldered Galilean fisherman about forty, square face, thick curly grey-streaked dark hair and full grey-streaked beard, brown tunic with a slate-blue mantle.

john.desc: John son of Zebedee, the youngest disciple: about twenty, clean-shaven, wavy chestnut-brown hair, olive-green tunic with an ochre mantle.

andrew.desc: Andrew, Peter's brother: lean fisherman about thirty-five, long narrow face, straight black hair and a thin dark beard, sand-colored tunic with a moss-green mantle.

james.desc: James son of Zebedee: sturdy man about thirty, short black curly hair and short black beard, intense eyes, charcoal-grey tunic with a rust-brown mantle.

joseph.desc: Joseph of Nazareth, the carpenter: kind man about thirty-five, short dark beard, wears a cream headcloth with a brown band, earth-brown tunic and a light tan mantle, strong carpenter's hands.

baptist.desc: John the Baptist: lean, weathered desert prophet about thirty, wild long black hair and untrimmed beard, rough camel-hair garment tied with a leather belt, bare arms.

judas.desc: Judas Iscariot: thin man about thirty-five, sharp features, close-cropped black hair and short neat black beard, dark olive-grey tunic and mantle, a small leather money bag at his belt.

thomas.desc: Thomas: medium build man about thirty, short curly brown hair and short beard, thoughtful furrowed brow, grey-blue tunic with a beige mantle.

magdalene.desc: Mary Magdalene: woman about thirty, striking dark eyes, long black hair partly covered by a plum-purple veil, cream dress.

martha.desc: Martha of Bethany: capable woman about thirty-five, warm round face, hair under a mustard-yellow headscarf, brown dress with an apron cloth. Her sister Mary of Bethany is younger, slender, with a soft grey veil.

lazarus.desc: Lazarus of Bethany: gentle man about thirty-five, pale olive skin, short brown hair and short beard, simple white linen tunic.

nicodemus.desc: Nicodemus: dignified older Pharisee about sixty, long white beard, white robe with blue fringed prayer shawl and a blue headband.

pilate.desc: Pontius Pilate: clean-shaven Roman governor about fifty, short grey hair, white toga with a broad purple stripe, stern tired face.

caiaphas.desc: Caiaphas the high priest: stern man about fifty, long dark beard with grey, tall white turban with a gold band, white robe under a blue sleeveless ephod-like mantle.
